title: grepai project configuration
description: Schema for .grepai/config.yaml, the per-project grepai configuration. Source of truth: config/config.go (Config struct, DefaultConfig, applyDefaults, validators); consumers verified in embedder/factory.go, cli/ (index, watch, search, init), mcp/server.go, search/, indexer/, trace/, rpg/, framework/. Reflects main at v1.1.0 + follow-up commits (2026-10-28). Notes: grepai itself silently ignores unknown YAML keys; this schema sets additionalProperties:false to flag typos. Every option is optional at load time - missing or zero values are filled from defaults. The global multi-project file ~/.grepai/workspace.yaml is described separately in #/$defs/workspaceFile.

version.description: Config format version. Only 1 exists today.

chunking.description: How source files are split into embeddable chunks. Consumed by indexer.NewFileChunker and indexer.Scanner.

size.description: Target chunk size in tokens (approx. 4 chars per token). With strategy=ast the budget is converted to non-whitespace characters. 0 or missing resets to 512 at load.

overlap.description: Overlap between consecutive chunks in tokens. Unused by strategy=ast. 0 or missing resets to 50 at load (so 0 cannot be forced).

strategy.description: fixed: sliding window of size+overlap. ast: cAST recursive split-then-merge respecting syntax trees; covers .go .js .jsx .ts .tsx .py, every other file falls back to fixed. Requires a build with the treesitter tag + CGO (enabled on main after the v1.1.0 release, commit 87a66ac); in builds without it, logs a warning and falls back to fixed. Unknown values also fall back to fixed with a warning.

custom_extensions.description: Extra file extensions to index beyond the built-in SupportedExtensions list (e.g. [".tengo", ".el"]). Each entry needs the leading dot; matched case-insensitively. Binary detection (UTF-8 + null-byte check) still applies, so adding a binary extension is safe.

framework_processing.description: Node-based preprocessing of single-file components (Vue/Svelte/Astro/Solid) before chunking and symbol extraction, with line numbers remapped to the original file. Consumed by cli/buildFrameworkRegistry -> framework.ProcessorRegistry.

enabled.description: Master switch. false forces mode=off (source passes through untouched), regardless of mode.

mode.description: auto: transform when the processor is available, otherwise pass through with a warning. require: hard-error when a matched processor is unavailable (e.g. node not found). off: never transform.

node_path.description: Node.js executable used by the Vue compiler. Empty resets to 'node'.

frameworks.description: Per-framework switches. Omitting a whole framework block inherits the shipped default (vue: true, svelte/astro/solid: false).

enabled.description: Vue SFC processor: real compiler implementation, runs via node_path. Default on.
Scaffold processor: in auto mode falls back to passthrough; in require mode it fails. Default off.
Scaffold processor: in auto mode falls back to passthrough; in require mode it fails. Default off.
Scaffold processor: in auto mode falls back to passthrough; in require mode it fails. Default off.

watch.description: Daemon behavior (grepai watch). The four rpg_* timings are validated at config load - invalid values make every command fail, not just watch.

debounce_ms.description: Debounce window for filesystem events before incremental reindexing. 0 or missing resets to 500.

last_index_time.description: INTERNAL - managed by grepai, do not edit. Timestamp persisted after each indexing pass; drives incremental indexing. Read by cli/index.go, written back into config.yaml by the watcher.

rpg_persist_interval_ms.description: How often the watcher flushes the RPG graph to .grepai/rpg.gob. Validated at load: must be >= 200.

rpg_derived_debounce_ms.description: Debounce for recomputing derived RPG edges (invokes/imports/semantic). Validated at load: must be >= 100.

rpg_full_reconcile_interval_sec.description: Period between full RPG reconciliation passes. Validated at load: must be >= 30.

rpg_max_dirty_files_per_batch.description: Cap on dirty files processed per RPG update batch. Validated at load: must be >= 1.

discover_worktrees.description: Set false to stop grepai watch from auto-initializing and watching linked git worktrees. Only the main worktree's config is consulted; the key is ignored in linked-worktree config copies.

search.description: Query-time ranking options. Consumed by search.NewSearcher (both CLI search and the MCP server).

boost.description: Path-based score multipliers applied after retrieval, before ranking.

enabled.description: Apply boost rules to search results.

penalties.description: Rules with factor < 1 demote matching paths. Shipped defaults penalize tests, mocks, fixtures, generated code and docs.

bonuses.description: Rules with factor > 1 promote matching paths.

hybrid.description: Vector + keyword search fused with Reciprocal Rank Fusion.

enabled.description: Fuse vector search with naive word-overlap text search via RRF. Works on every backend (gob, postgres, qdrant all implement GetAllChunks), but loads ALL chunks through the store to score them - costly on large indexes.

k.description: RRF constant. Values <= 0 fall back to 60 at runtime.

enabled.description: Keep only the highest-scoring chunk per file (over-fetches 4x, then collapses to one result per file).

trace.description: Symbol extraction for trace/refs call graphs (grepai trace, grepai refs, MCP equivalents).

enabled_languages.description: File extensions whose files get symbol/reference extraction. An empty array falls back to the shipped default. Fast regex extractor coverage: .go .js .ts .jsx .tsx .py .php .lua .c .h .zig .rs .cpp .hpp .cc .cxx .hxx .java .cs .pas .dpr .fs .fsx .fsi .gd .rb; precise tree-sitter extractor (treesitter builds) covers .go .js .jsx .ts .tsx .py .php .cs .fs .fsx .fsi. Extensions outside extractor coverage are read but yield no symbols. .vue works through framework_processing.

rpg.description: Repository Program Graph (.grepai/rpg.gob): hierarchy of code entities with invokes/imports/semantic edges, queried via grepai rpg search/fetch/explore. All numeric ranges below are validated at config load ONLY when enabled=true (see the conditional at the end of this schema).

enabled.description: Build and maintain the RPG graph during index/watch.

feature_mode.description: local: heuristic feature extraction. llm / hybrid: extract features with an OpenAI-compatible chat model (llm_endpoint, llm_model); when llm_model or llm_endpoint is empty, falls back to the local extractor with a warning.

drift_threshold.description: Jaccard drift above which a modified file is re-placed in the feature hierarchy (0 = never, 1 = always). Valid range 0.0-1.0 when rpg.enabled. A literal 0 is treated as unset and resets to 0.35.

max_traversal_depth.description: Hierarchy traversal depth bound. Valid range 1-10 when rpg.enabled. Values <= 0 reset to 3.

llm_provider.description: Provider label for the RPG LLM extractor (informational; requests go to llm_endpoint). Empty resets to ollama.

llm_model.description: Chat model for feature extraction. NO default - deliberately left empty; empty means llm/hybrid modes fall back to the local extractor.

llm_endpoint.description: OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint for the RPG LLM extractor.

llm_api_key.description: API key for the RPG LLM endpoint (optional for local endpoints).

llm_timeout_ms.description: Per-request timeout for the RPG LLM extractor. Values <= 0 reset to 8000.

feature_group_strategy.description: How oversized feature groups are handled: sample picks representatives, split divides them.

ignore.description: Extra ignore entries layered on top of every .gitignore found in the project. Entries are matched both as directory names (skip subtree) and as gitignore-style patterns anchored at the project root. Nested .grepaiignore files can re-include (override) these.

external_gitignore.description: Path to an additional gitignore file applied from the project root (supports ~/ expansion). A missing file only logs a warning.

embedderConfig.description: Embedding provider settings. Consumed by embedder.NewFromConfig (CLI + MCP).

provider.description: Embedding provider. Empty resets to ollama; unknown values fail at runtime with 'unknown embedding provider'.

model.description: Model name. Per-provider defaults: ollama nomic-embed-text (768d); lmstudio text-embedding-nomic-embed-text-v1.5 (768d); openai text-embedding-3-small (1536d); synthetic hf:nomic-ai/nomic-embed-text-v1.5; openrouter openai/text-embedding-3-small; requesty openai/text-embedding-3-small.

endpoint.description: Provider endpoint; when empty the per-provider default is filled in at load: ollama http://localhost:11434; lmstudio http://127.0.0.1:1234; openai https://api.openai.com/v1; synthetic https://api.synthetic.new/openai/v1; openrouter https://openrouter.ai/api/v1; requesty https://router.requesty.ai/v1.

api_key.description: API key for cloud providers. When empty, resolved from the environment: openai <- OPENAI_API_KEY; synthetic <- SYNTHETIC_API_KEY then OPENAI_API_KEY; openrouter <- OPENROUTER_API_KEY then OPENAI_API_KEY; requesty <- REQUESTY_API_KEY then OPENAI_API_KEY. Local providers (ollama, lmstudio) ignore it. Excluded from the embedding-cache namespace, so rotating the key does not invalidate the index.

dimensions.description: Vector dimensionality. Local providers (ollama, lmstudio, synthetic) default to 768 when unset. For openai/openrouter/requesty, unset means the model's native dimensions (1536 for *-small, 3072 for *-large, 4096 for qwen3-embedding-8b). Must match what the model actually returns: the embedder identity (provider+model+dimensions+endpoint) is recorded in .grepai/index.meta and a mismatch triggers a rebuild/warning.

parallelism.description: Parallel workers for batch embedding. Consumed ONLY by the openai provider; other providers ignore it. Values <= 0 reset to 4.

request_timeout_seconds.description: HTTP timeout for a single embedding request. 0/absent keeps the provider default (60s; synthetic 90s). Raise it for slow self-hosted endpoints (e.g. ollama on a shared GPU). Consumed by all providers EXCEPT requesty.

max_retries.description: Retry attempts for transient failures (HTTP 429/5xx, exponential backoff 1s-32s). 0/absent keeps the default of 5. Consumed ONLY by the openai provider.

max_batch_size.description: Max inputs per embedding request. 0/absent keeps the OpenAI limit of 2000. Lower it for OpenAI-compatible endpoints that reject large batches. Consumed ONLY by the openai provider.

max_batch_tokens.description: Max estimated tokens per embedding request. 0/absent keeps the OpenAI limit of 280000. Consumed ONLY by the openai provider.

storeConfig.description: Vector store settings. Consumed by cli + mcp/server.go createStore.

backend.description: gob: single-file .grepai/index.gob, per-project, not shareable (warns when too large). postgres: pgvector. qdrant: gRPC client. Empty resets to gob; unknown values fail at store creation.

dsn.description: PostgreSQL connection string for the pgvector database.

endpoint.description: Qdrant host or base URL, e.g. localhost or http://localhost.

port.description: gRPC port (6334). The REST port 6333 is not used. Values <= 0 reset to 6334 when backend=qdrant.

collection.description: Collection name. When empty, derived from the sanitized absolute project path.

use_tls.description: Enable TLS on the gRPC connection (for Qdrant Cloud).

pattern.description: Case-sensitive substring matched against the slash-separated project-relative path with a leading '/' prepended (so '/src/', '.test.', '__tests__' all work as expected).

factor.description: Score multiplier: < 1 penalizes, > 1 boosts. All matching rules multiply together; results are re-sorted afterwards.

rpgEnabled.description: Extra constraints enforced by ValidateRPGConfig when rpg.enabled is true. grepai rejects the whole config on violation.

workspaceFile.title: ~/.grepai/workspace.yaml (global multi-project workspace config)
workspaceFile.description: Separate global file for cross-project workspaces; NOT part of .grepai/config.yaml. Managed by grepai workspace create/add/remove. Only store + embedder are consumed at query time; chunking provides workspace-level defaults of which ONLY custom_extensions is currently consumed (size/overlap/strategy come from each project's own config).

workspaces.description: Map of workspace name to workspace definition.

store.description: gob is rejected for workspaces (file-based, cannot be shared); only postgres and qdrant are valid.

custom_extensions.description: The only chunking key consumed at workspace level.

name.description: Project name used in path prefixes and --project filters.

path.description: Absolute path to the project root.
